name: lodestone
description: Mirrors the main justfile recipes for machines without `just`.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix e2e install && cd e2e && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.dev:demo: cd frontend && VITE_LODESTONE_MODE=demo npm run dev
scripts.test: cd backend && cargo test && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:contract: node scripts/with-backend.mjs -- npm --prefix frontend test -- src/api/contract.test.ts
scripts.e2e: npm --prefix frontend run build:live && cd e2e && npx playwright test
